name: 2026 Scottsdale Headache Symposium
venue: The Westin Kierland Resort and Spa
description: The American Headache Society holds its Scottsdale Headache Symposium at the Westin Kierland Resort and Spa in Scottsdale, Arizona, from 3 to 6 December 2026. The symposium offers continuing medical education on the diagnosis and treatment of headache disorders.

deadlines.label: Registration cancellation deadline
deadlines.note: Also the hotel room block cutoff date for the discounted group rate; cancellations after this date forfeit a 100 dollar processing fee.

sources.note: Confirms dates, venue, hotel cutoff and cancellation deadline.

notes: No open call for abstracts was found for this symposium; the program appears to be faculty organized rather than abstract driven.
